## Data cleaning:
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
loan_data_raw <- read_excel("loan_data.xlsx")

#Filter out unrealistic demographic outliers. 
loan_data <- loan_data_raw %>%
  filter(person_age < 100,
         person_emp_exp < 80,
         person_emp_exp < person_age,
         cb_person_cred_hist_length < person_age) %>%
#Convert loan_status into categorical factor
#Encode binary text flag ('Yes'/'No') to numeric (1/0)
  mutate(loan_status = factor(loan_status),
         previous_loan_defaults_on_file = ifelse(previous_loan_defaults_on_file == "Yes", 1, 0),
#Bind continuous income into 4 equal quartiles for later graph use
         income_group = cut(
           person_income,
           breaks = quantile(person_income, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
           labels = c("Low Income", "Lower-Middle", "Upper-Middle", "High Income"),
           include.lowest = TRUE)
         )
write_csv(loan_data, "loan_cleaned.csv")
```
